proof_scope: live provider dispatch through the real Ask runtime

claims.proves: that a seat either answers with real content or names its blocker, that a rate-limited seat self-recovers to its configured fallback AND records the substitution, and that no seat dispatches a nonexistent model
claims.does_not_prove: that any given provider is available at run time, browser seat completion, or semantic correctness of any response

cases.name: live-no-seat-dispatches-a-nonexistent-model
command: cd .. && ./run.sh live-seat-probe claude-fable-low --json 2>/dev/null | grep -c model_not_available || true

cases.name: a-non-selected-tab-is-hidden-so-seats-need-own-windows
command: cd ../../surf && OUT=$(./run.sh window.new 'https://example.com' --unfocused 2>&1) && W=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -oE 'Window [0-9]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}') && T1=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}') && T2=$(./run.sh tab.new 'https://example.org' --background --window-id "$W" 2>&1 | grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}') && A=$(./run.sh js --tab-id "$T1" --no-activate 'document.hidden' 2>&1 | tail -1) && B=$(./run.sh js --tab-id "$T2" --no-activate 'document.hidden' 2>&1 | tail -1) && ./run.sh window.close "$W" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "selected=$A second=$B"; case "$A$B" in *false*true*) echo SECOND_TAB_IS_HIDDEN;; esac

cases.name: live-a-removed-web-seat-is-refilled-locally-and-recorded
command: cd .. && ./run.sh tau-dag 'Reply with exactly: SUBSTITUTE-OK' --repo local/agent-skills --target eval-substitute --immutable-goal 'Return the token or name a blocker.' --handler webgemini --execute --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,re,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();m=re.search(r'^{',t,re.M);d=json.loads(t[m.start():]);sel=(d.get('execution') or {}).get('browser_provider_selection') or d.get('browser_provider_selection') or {};subs=sel.get('local_substitutions') or [];rem=sel.get('removed_handlers') or [];assert not rem or subs, ('a seat was removed with no recorded substitution', rem);print('SEAT_HONEST')"

cases.name: an-ambient-rate-limited-tab-does-not-remove-a-seat
an-unbound-browser-run-opens-a-fresh-tab
command:
cd .. && uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src')
import ask.tau_dag_cli as c
class I:
    handlers=['webgpt']; workflow_mode='single'; handler_projects=[]
# reuse-bound with nothing bound is what let 20 ambient tabs decide availability
import inspect
src=inspect.getsource(c._provision_browser_lifecycle)
assert 'unbound' in src, 'unbound runs no longer choose a fresh tab'
print('FRESH_TAB_WHEN_UNBOUND')"

cases.name: live-webdeepseek-reads-an-attached-image
command: cd ../../surf && printf 'What animal is in the attached image? Answer with the single species name only.' > /tmp/ask-eval-vision.md && ./run.sh deepseek.submit --input /tmp/ask-eval-vision.md --output /tmp/ask-eval-vision-out.md --mode Vision --attach-file ../ask/fixtures/lion.jpg --timeout 400 >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -qi lion /tmp/ask-eval-vision-out.md && echo VISION_READ_THE_IMAGE

cases.name: the-surf-host-runs-from-the-main-checkout
command: ps aux | grep 'surf-cli/native/host.cjs' | grep -v grep | grep -q '/agent-skills/skills/surf' && echo HOST_ON_MAIN

cases.name: live-a-run-leaves-a-readable-handoff-chain
command: cd .. && ./run.sh tau-dag 'Reply with exactly: HANDOFF-EVAL' --repo local/agent-skills --target handoff-eval --immutable-goal 'Return the token.' --dag-template single-call --handler claude-opus-5-high --execute --json >/dev/null 2>&1; ./run.sh handoff | grep -q 'human' && echo HANDOFF_CHAIN_READABLE
